name: zotero
description: Zotero 7 literature workflow: ingest IEEE/arXiv/DOI/BibTeX papers into local Zotero via reverse SSH (paper-bridge) and search or read full text back via private read-only MCP.
author: Shuieng Yuan
suggestedPrompts: 检查 Zotero Paper Bridge 隧道状态并列出我的 Zotero 分类目录
把这篇 IEEE/arXiv 论文下载到 Zotero 的 Agent-Inbox 并读回全文总结要点
在我的 Zotero 文献库中检索相关论文并提取核心方法对比
